source.publication: Capital Markets Soundness Report (CMSR), Quarter 4 FY 2025/2026 (1 April - 30 June 2026)
source.theme: Collective Investment Schemes as a Catalyst for Financial Inclusion and Capital Markets Deepening
source.permission: CMA states it has no objection to the material being referenced provided an acknowledgment is made. Every figure below is acknowledged to the CMA.
source.note: Figures in the CIS special feature are reported as at Q1 2026 / March 2026 even though the report covers the quarter to 30 June 2026. The as_of field on each block states which.

yields.why: The CMA does not publish a fund yield. Every yield in this report is a government bond yield; there is no per-fund effective annual rate, daily rate or return anywhere in it. A 2019 CIS report did carry a 'Yield of Money Market Funds' table with Daily Yield and Effective Annual Rate columns; that table is not in current CMA reporting. Current Kenyan MMF rates are published by each fund manager, not by the regulator, and they are not like-for-like: some are gross of the 15 per cent withholding tax, some net of fees, some a three-month average. Nothing is shown here rather than a rate the regulator did not publish.

categories.basis: Q1 2026, share of total CIS assets under management
categories.definitions_source: CMA's own category definitions, CMSR Q4 FY2025/2026 section 1.2

rows.definition: Invest primarily in short-term, low-risk instruments such as Treasury bills, fixed deposits and commercial paper, offering relatively stable returns and high liquidity.
Focus on specific sectors, investment themes or asset classes to meet targeted investor preferences.
Invest in government and corporate bonds to generate regular income and preserve capital.
Invest mainly in listed shares with the objective of achieving long-term capital appreciation.
rows.aum_note: The report gives this category's share but not its shilling amount.

rows.definition: Combine investments in equities, bonds and money market instruments to achieve both income generation and capital growth.
rows.aum_note: The report gives this category's share but not its shilling amount.
